question: B Adhiban led a star-studded field at the 58th Senior National ________ Championship, which began on 25 February 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chess.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****58th Senior National Chess Championship:**

__
 
• **Star-studded field led by Grandmaster B Adhiban began on February 25, 2022.**
 
• For the first time, 30 International Masters and 23 Grand Masters are taking part in the national championship.
 
• It was held in** Kanpur.**
 
• The reward money for the winner is expected to be Rs 6 lakh.
 
• The winner will also get 25 bonus points.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****National Chess Championship:**

 
• It's India's yearly national chess championship.
 
• It was** founded in 1955 **by the Andhra State Chess Federation.
 
• Originally held every two years, it has been played annually since 1971.
 
• Andhra Pradesh's** Eluru hosted the event's debut edition.**
 
• In 1974, the women's championship was launched.
 
• The **59th MPL Senior National Chess Championship 2022 **took place at the IG Stadium in **New Delhi.**
 
• **Pune **hosted the **60th Senior National Chess Championship **in 2023 from August 16–26.
